title: Manin's conjecture for semi-integral curves and $\mathbb A^1$-connectedness
summary: We explore log Manin's conjecture for integral points and its connections to $\mathbb A^1$-connectedness. We prove log Manin's conjecture for Campana rational curves and for $\mathbb A^1$-curves on split toric varieties. Our arguments combine the Cox ring description of the moduli space of rational curves with Batyrev's heuristic-type counting arguments. As our proofs are geometric in nature, they give a geometric explanation of the mysterious leading constant for Campana points proposed by Chow--Loughran--Takloo-Bighash--Tanimoto.
